players.product: precision timing and high-speed connectivity for 800G and 1.6T AI data-center platforms

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 FY2026 revenue was $935 million with non-GAAP EPS of $1.08, both above guidance midpoint. Broad Markets was 43% of sales, grew 8% year-over-year and was led by double-digit growth in data center and automotive; gross margin was approximately 45%.
quarterly_data.figure: $935M revenue; $1.08 EPS; Broad Markets 43% of sales, +8% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: AI data center is Skyworks' fastest-growing business and is running ahead of the greater-than-50% annual growth outlook given last quarter despite supply constraints. Engagements cover high-speed connectivity as customers move to 800G and 1.6T, with precision timing demand rising alongside data rates and rack density.
quarterly_data.figure: AI data-center growth >50% annually; 800G/1.6T connectivity and precision timing

quarterly_data.signal: Demand for the Wi-Fi, data-center and automotive growth engines is running well ahead of supply; data-center demand accelerated above 50%, book-to-bill remained above 1 and channel inventories were lean. Management characterized the shortages as broad-based across faster-growing products.
quarterly_data.figure: data-center demand >50% growth and supply-constrained; book-to-bill >1

quarterly_data.signal: Q4 FY2026 guidance calls for revenue of $1.01-$1.06 billion, gross margin of 44%-45% and non-GAAP EPS of $1.27 at the midpoint. Broad Markets is expected to grow about 5% year-over-year and represent about 39% of sales.

The three Broad Markets growth engines - Wi-Fi, data center and automotive - represented nearly two-thirds of Broad Markets revenue and collectively grew 15% year-over-year, with solid Wi-Fi 7 backlog and early Wi-Fi 8 customer collaboration.
quarterly_data.figure: growth engines nearly 2/3 of Broad Markets, +15% YoY

players.product: advanced power-delivery semiconductors for 400V and 800V HVDC AI data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Skyworks is engaged with leading data-center customers on the transition to 400V and 800V HVDC architectures. Rising rack density is driving demand for its advanced power-delivery solutions alongside its precision timing portfolio, and AI data center is the company's fastest-growing business at more than 50% annual growth.
quarterly_data.figure: 400V/800V HVDC power transition; AI data-center growth >50%

quarterly_data.signal: Demand across Skyworks' data-center, automotive and Wi-Fi growth engines is ahead of available supply. Management said data-center demand accelerated above the prior greater-than-50% outlook while shortages remained broad-based across the faster-growing products.
quarterly_data.figure: data-center demand above >50% outlook and constrained by supply
